model_annotation: The diagram is a bar graph showing the results of a survey question, "B2. Какъв е дизайнът подходът за Вас, имайки предвид възможните дизайн практики във вашата организация?" (B2. What is the design approach for you, considering the possible design practices in your organization?). The graph has seven categories, each represented by a different color. The categories are: "Дизайнът е бизнес стратегия" (Design is a business strategy), 36 respondents (blue, approximately 26%); "Дизайнът е стандартизиран..." (Design is standardized...), 14 respondents (orange, approximately 10%); "Дизайнът е експериментална..." (Design is experimental...), 16 respondents (green, approximately 12%); "Дизайнът е стока, която се случ..." (Design is a product that happens...), 13 respondents (red, approximately 9%); "Дизайнът прави продуктите да..." (Design makes products...), 41 respondents (purple, approximately 30%); "Дизайнът е процес, насочен к..." (Design is a process focused on...), 52 respondents (brown, approximately 38%); and "Не ми е известно / Нямам инф..." (Not known to me / No information...), 10 respondents (pink, approximately 7%). The graph includes a legend and displays the number of respondents for each category on the y-axis, ranging from 0 to 60. Notably, the categories are not arranged in a specific order, such as descending or ascending, and none of the categories are visually emphasized. The diagram provides a clear visual representation of the survey results, allowing for easy comparison of the different design approaches.
